userStories.title: M10d: zero-AI & cost guardrails — hidden entries without keys, monthly token cap, usage view
userStories.description: As a workspace admin without an AI key, I want every Syna entry hidden (or a one-line 'Connect a provider' link for admins) and a per-workspace monthly token cap with a usage view so that the product is complete with AI off. Starting state: partial — Audit tab + event-logs usage exist (US-045); no zero-AI entry gating and no per-workspace cap.

Usage view in Settings → Syna (reuse the Audit tab's event-logs surface; no new billing backend)
